title: One-Step Generative Modeling via Wasserstein Gradient Flows
tldr_zh: W-Flow 用 Sinkhorn divergence 的 WGF 速度场 T_{q,p}−T_{q,q} 规定训练期粒子演化，一步生成器回归之；作者报告 ImageNet-256 一步 FID 1.29
tldr_en: W-Flow drives a one-step generator by the Wasserstein gradient flow of the Sinkhorn divergence (cross minus self barycentric maps); authors report 1.29 FID on ImageNet-256 in 1 NFE.
key_numbers: ImageNet 256x256 class-conditional, 1 NFE: W-Flow XL/2 FID 1.29 / IS 265.4; L/2 1.35 / 272.5; B/2 1.52 / 271.8 (Table 3)
Baselines: Drifting Model L/2 1.54, iMeanFlow-XL/2 1.72, LightningDiT-XL/2 (250x2 NFE) 1.35, RAE+DiTDH-XL/2 1.13 (Table 3)
Energy ablation (B/2, 100 ep): Sinkhorn 7.29 vs Drifting 8.46 vs KL 10.17 vs MMD 10.40 FID (Table 2a); velocity CFG improves to 7.08 (Table 2b)
Self-transport estimator: one-batch 17.57 vs diagonal mask 7.45 vs two-batch 7.08 FID (Table 2c)
Theorem B.4: sup_t W2(empirical, q_t) <= e^{(L1+L2)T} W2(q0^N,q0) + ... + C_T eta (m2 terms); Sinkhorn Lipschitz constant <= diam^2/(2 eps) (Lemma B.6)
